summary: Fastenal Company filed an 8-K to report routine refinancing of its credit facilities. The company entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement renewing an $835 million revolving credit line (with an accordion up to $1.335 billion), extended the maturity to June 2031, and modified financial covenants. It also amended its Master Note Agreement reducing the maximum principal from $900 million to an unspecified lower amount. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is present. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit arrangements, not a special situation.
